#592 · Floating Pokémon

Frillish

Water Ghost

Unova · Generation 5

Frillish is a Water/Ghost-type Floating Pokémon first found in Unova (Generation 5). It stands 1.2 m tall and weighs 33 kg. It evolves into Jellicent. Its highest base stat is Sp. Def (85), with a base stat total of 335.
